I'm torn between two approaches. I could use Google Drive, which would take around 2 hours to upload everything – their servers are pretty fast and it integrates well with my system. I'm already paying $2 a month for the storage anyway. The thing is, Google can technically scan the contents and it's all under US jurisdiction, which makes me a little uneasy given how sensitive this stuff is. On the plus side, it's super reliable and I could easily access the files from the repair shop if I needed to. The other option is just using my external SSD, which would be way faster – probably only 30 minutes with USB 3.0. It's free since I already own it, and everything would stay completely private with me. But physical drives can fail or get lost, and I'd have to remember to bring it with me if I need to grab any files while the laptop's being worked on. What would you go with?
